content_blocks.title: Core idea
content_blocks.text:
Resource correctness depends on object lifetime, copying, moving and error paths. RAII and the Rule of Zero reduce manual cleanup and make exceptions safer.

Resource Acquisition Is Initialization (RAII) focuses on the decisions and observable behavior named by the subtopics below. The aim is to explain the rule, predict what a small program should do, and then confirm the result with a focused check.

Trace which object owns each resource before and after a copy, move, early return or exception.

items.title: The RAII Principle
items.text: RAII ties resource ownership to object lifetime, making cleanup happen reliably as objects are destroyed, including during exception unwinding.
